# Tontatta

![](../../assets/playable/racenomi/gui/icons/tontatta.png){ .entry-page-icon }

![](../../assets/playable/racenomi/abilities/ant_burden.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

## Tontatta Strength

![](../../assets/playable/racenomi/abilities/tontatta_strength.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

The user is tiny but their blows push as hard as a man's and they reach blocks further than their size. They are a little quicker than a man, in the air too, jump up to three blocks higher the longer the jump is held and fall from higher unhurt
